summary: Every owner turn sent by submitToOpenClawAgent now starts with the Tunis local time in the SDK's own envelope format ([DOW YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM TZ], kept as is by the SDK LLM boundary, persisted with the message, stripped at display), and the owner context gets a static ## HORLOGE notice telling the brain to answer time, date, day and relative dates from it without any tool. Non-owner and slash turns are unchanged.
reason: S24 31/10 brain-only voice bench: « quelle heure est-il » took 12.0 s against 6.2 s for a no-tool turn. OpenClaw 2026.9.6's Temporal Context gives the date only and says « For the exact current time, use session_status », a core tool behind Tool Search: two extra model steps (2.5-3.8 s each). The SDK message stamp follows the host time zone, not guaranteed to be Tunis on Termux.
